scope: First exact realization of shared-nuisance source inference; NOT all possible causal M1 methods
candidate: Persistent source-by-nuisance joint likelihood, same nuisance prior for all source candidates, marginalize nuisance only after accumulating blocks
comparator: Ordinary Bayesian inverse inference using identical prediction tensor, source/nuisance priors and block likelihood
observation_likelihood: Gaussian iid block errors with specified sigma; a synthetic probe assumption, not a fitted House noise model
nuisance: A whole transport/source-strength/sensor-initial-state trajectory per member, not independently resampled blocks
checks: Independent implementations agree or differ on deterministic nondegenerate tensors
Persistent nuisance must not become independent block-wise nuisance
Permutation of exchangeable member labels does not create source information
Two sources with swapped nuisance responses and equal nuisance weights are observationally indistinguishable
An independent nuisance observation may break that ambiguity, but benefits the same-input ordinary baseline too
Unknown source strength can make proportional spatial response profiles coincide
kill_rule: If candidate is algebraically and numerically the ordinary baseline, reject it as a separately established causal M1 contribution; do not launch House experiments for this formulation
identifiability_boundary: A nonzero source response contrast at matched latent nuisance is not sufficient when that nuisance is unobserved
cost_boundary: Synthetic arithmetic only; no bank payload, no new House/source worlds, no experimental seeds, no ROS batch
next_batch_if_later_qualified: H01/H02/H03 seed12 only; no automatic multiseed
